title: Deliver Rubber to Duningpool Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Rubber** delivered to **Duningpool Factory** (industry id 10, near tile 22,119).

A likely supplier is **Duningpool Rubber Plantation** (industry id 7, near tile 13,83); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **6,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
